title: GM gas engines (2000-2025): rough idle, crank no start or misfire from carbon on the valves, top-engine decarbon
summary: GM bulletin 16-NA-383: heavy carbon on intake and/or exhaust valves can stick valves and cause rough idle, extended crank, no start and P0300-P0308, usually after 5,000+ miles. Cold compression can read 0 psi on several cylinders. GM's fix is a top-engine cleaner run through the throttle body at 2,000 rpm, plus an oil change and Top Tier fuel.
warnings: Don't hydro-lock the engine. Inducing too much cleaner, or at too low an rpm, or stalling the engine with it, can bend connecting rods.

specs.name: Cold compression
specs.value: May read 0 kPa (0 psi) on multiple cylinders

specs.name: Cleaner
specs.value: ACDelco Air Intake, Valve and Combustion Chamber Cleaner, about 650 mL (22 oz, 2 cans)

specs.name: Tool air pressure
specs.value: 260 kPa (40 psi) at the service tool (Fuel Injector Cleaner Kit J-35800-A, nozzle EN-35800-20)

specs.name: Engine speed while inducing
specs.value: 2,000 rpm commanded with the scan tool

specs.name: Fuel tank additive
specs.value: ACDelco Fuel System Cleaner 44K, 19435370 (U.S. and Canada)

steps.text: Symptoms: rough idle, crank no start, extended crank or misfire, sometimes popping through the intake or exhaust while cranking and fuel-fouled plugs. Service manual diagnosis may not catch it if the valves aren't sticking at that moment.

Run the normal service information diagnosis. If it points to compression loss from valve sealing and rules out everything external to the engine, check for valve damage or out-of-place cam followers.
No damage: do the decarbon procedure to free sticking valves. Damage: do the mechanical repair first, then the decarbon procedure to keep it from coming back.
Fill the J-35800-A kit with about 650 mL (2 cans) of the GM cleaner, cap it tight, and set 40 psi (260 kPa) at the tool.

Engine at operating temperature, in a well-ventilated area: command 2,000 rpm with the scan tool and slowly induce the cleaner through the throttle body with the EN-35800-20 nozzle over about 3 minutes. A second application may be needed.
Let it idle 2 minutes after the can is empty, then change the oil and filter.

Test drive with light throttle and clear codes. Tell the owner to use Top Tier gasoline; GM also suggests a bottle of 44K fuel system cleaner at every oil change. GM doesn't approve aftermarket top-engine cleaners.

sources.title: Service Bulletin 16-NA-383: Information on Rough Idle, Crank No Start, Extended Crank or Misfire Due to Excessive Carbon on Top of Valves or Sticking Valves - DTC P0300-P0308
